_comment: A mystery, told as one. The stars are going out, and every activity answers a question the one before it raised. WHAT is happening? Stars are missing, in a line (compare). WHY? Something flat is passing in front of them — a page (experiment). WHO saw it? The stars it covered; relight them and they speak (mix). HOW do we get there? Join the relit stars into a path (trace). WHO has it? Rule the travellers out, clue by clue, until one is left (deduce). Take any one away and the next has nothing to stand on.
_shapeComment: Five activities, not six. The Ocean's six sat at the top of the eight-to-twelve minutes attention holds at four to five, and this chapter's activities are each longer to think about than the Ocean's were — deducing, experimenting and mixing all ask a child to try something before answering. Fewer, deeper, and every one of them on screen for a reason.
_agencyComment: Suha never solves anything. She shines, she carries, and she says what she saw — but the rule about shadows, the colours, the path and the answer are all the child's. The reveal is theirs too: the success line of the climax names the comet only after the child has left it standing.
_arcComment: The chapter closes the Stars mystery and opens the arc's. The comet did not take the page, it caught it; and it saw that every page rode the same wind. That is the thread Adventure 5 picks up, and all this chapter says about it is that the wind came from somewhere.

lines.en: Above the clouds, the night is going out, one star at a time.
lines.ar: فَوْقَ الغُيُومِ يَنْطَفِئُ اللَّيْل، نَجْمَةً بَعْدَ نَجْمَة.

lines.en: The smallest star, Suha, saw something flat and dark slide past her.
lines.ar: رَأَتْ أَصْغَرُ نَجْمَةٍ، سُهَى، شَيْئًا مُسَطَّحًا مُظْلِمًا يَنْزَلِقُ بِجَانِبِهَا.

lines.en: The Blue Page has a picture of this sky. Hold it up, and compare.
lines.ar: فِي الصَّفْحَةِ الزَّرْقَاءِ صُورَةٌ لِهَذِهِ السَّمَاء. اِرْفَعْهَا، وَقَارِن.

lines.en: Stars do not just vanish. Suha shines: see what happens when something passes in front.
lines.ar: النُّجُومُ لَا تَخْتَفِي هَكَذَا. تُضِيءُ سُهَى؛ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَحْدُثُ حِينَ يَمُرُّ شَيْءٌ أَمَامَهَا.

lines.en: So nobody is stealing the stars. Something flat, as big as a page, is passing in front of them.
lines.ar: إِذَنْ لَا أَحَدَ يَسْرِقُ النُّجُوم. شَيْءٌ مُسَطَّحٌ بِحَجْمِ صَفْحَةٍ يَمُرُّ أَمَامَهَا.

lines.en: The stars it covered went grey and cold. They saw it up close.
lines.ar: وَالنُّجُومُ الَّتِي غَطَّاهَا صَارَتْ رَمَادِيَّةً بَارِدَة. لَقَدْ رَأَتْهُ عَنْ قُرْب.

lines.en: Every star has its own colour. Mix the stardust, and each one you relight will say what it saw.
lines.ar: لِكُلِّ نَجْمَةٍ لَوْنُهَا. اِمْزُجْ غُبَارَ النُّجُوم، وَكُلُّ نَجْمَةٍ تُضِيئُهَا سَتَقُولُ مَا رَأَت.

lines.en: The relit stars make a path, up to where the sky travellers cross.
lines.ar: النُّجُومُ المُضِيئَةُ تَصْنَعُ دَرْبًا، يَصْعَدُ إِلَى حَيْثُ يَعْبُرُ مُسَافِرُو السَّمَاء.

lines.en: Six travellers cross here tonight, and one of them has the page. Suha does not know which. You can find out.
lines.ar: سِتَّةُ مُسَافِرِينَ يَعْبُرُونَ هُنَا اللَّيْلَة، وَأَحَدُهُمْ مَعَهُ الصَّفْحَة. سُهَى لَا تَعْرِفُ مَنْ. وَأَنْتَ تَسْتَطِيع.

lines.en: The comet never took the page. It caught on its tail, and a comet cannot look behind.
lines.ar: لَمْ يَأْخُذِ المُذَنَّبُ الصَّفْحَة. عَلِقَتْ بِذَيْلِه، وَالمُذَنَّبُ لَا يَرَى مَا خَلْفَه.

lines.en: Suha lifts it free, and every covered star shines again: the Silver Page.
lines.ar: تُحَرِّرُهَا سُهَى، فَتَلْمَعُ كُلُّ نَجْمَةٍ مُغَطَّاةٍ مِنْ جَدِيد: الصَّفْحَةُ الفِضِّيَّة.

lines.en: Before it goes, the comet says: it saw every page fly away on the same wind.
lines.ar: وَقَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْضِيَ يَقُولُ المُذَنَّب: رَأَى كُلَّ الصَّفَحَاتِ تَطِيرُ عَلَى رِيحٍ وَاحِدَة.

lines.en: And that wind did not blow by chance. It came from somewhere.
lines.ar: وَتِلْكَ الرِّيحُ لَمْ تَهُبَّ صُدْفَة. لَقَدْ جَاءَتْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ مَا.
